title: Example Inc. — Scheduling Software for Home Service Teams
metaDescription: Example Inc. builds dispatch and scheduling software for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical companies who need to keep technicians on the road without spreadsheet chaos.

h1: Scheduling software that keeps your trucks moving

images.alt: Dispatcher viewing the Example Inc. scheduling map

bodyText: Example Inc. helps home service companies stop coordinating technicians over the phone and text messages. Dispatchers get a live map of every truck, and the system automatically suggests the closest available technician for each new job. Companies using Example Inc. report cutting dispatcher call time by about half within the first month, and fewer missed appointment windows. The platform connects scheduling, a technician mobile app, customer text notifications, and invoicing into one screen so nothing falls through the cracks between the office and the field.

title: About Example Inc.
metaDescription: Example Inc. was founded in 2017 in Denver, CO to fix how home service companies schedule technicians.

images.alt: The Example Inc. team in the Denver office

bodyText: Example Inc. was founded in 2017 by Maria Chen, a former dispatcher at a Denver plumbing company who got tired of juggling a whiteboard and a two-way radio. Today the team is fully remote, spread across seven states, and serves customers across the US and Canada. Maria still spends one day a month riding along with a technician to see what's changed on the ground.

title: Services — Example Inc.
metaDescription: Dispatch scheduling, a technician mobile app, customer notifications, and invoicing — all in one platform.

h1: Everything dispatch needs in one place

bodyText: Dispatch Scheduling automatically matches the closest available technician to each incoming job, using live GPS and skill tags. The Technician Mobile App gives field staff their route, job notes, and photos in one place, even offline. Customer Notifications send automatic text and email updates when a technician is on the way, with a live map link. Invoicing & Payments lets technicians collect card payment on-site and syncs totals back to the office in real time.

title: Pricing — Example Inc.
metaDescription: Plans for teams from 5 to 50 technicians.
bodyText: Plans start at $39 per technician per month, billed annually, with no setup fee. Every plan includes dispatch scheduling, the mobile app, and customer notifications. Invoicing & Payments is available on the Growth plan and up. Teams over 50 technicians should contact sales for volume pricing.

title: Example Inc. Blog
metaDescription: Five ways to cut dispatcher call volume this month.

h1: Five ways to cut dispatcher call volume this month

bodyText:
One dispatcher we work with cut inbound status-check calls by 63% after turning on automatic ETA texts.

Self-assignment sounds risky, but teams that tried it saw average drive time drop by 18% because technicians picked jobs near their last stop.

First-time-fix rate is the number worth watching. A team stuck at 71% climbed to 84% just by requiring a photo of the nameplate before the job could be marked done.

None of this requires new hardware. Most teams started with the free trial and turned on one feature at a time.
author: Maria Chen

title: Example Inc. Blog
metaDescription: Three scheduling mistakes that quietly cost home service companies money.

h1: Three scheduling mistakes that quietly cost you money

bodyText: Double-booking usually isn't malicious, it's a shared spreadsheet with two people editing at once. Ignoring drive time between jobs is the second mistake; a job that looks fine on a calendar can be a 40-minute drive across town. Missed appointment windows compound quietly until a company realizes a third of Tuesday's jobs ran late.
